title: Your Europe — EU Council
overview: A comprehensive UX research engagement and information architecture redesign for the EU Council's Your Europe portal — a critical public service used by millions of EU citizens.

sections.label: Challenge
sections.content: The Your Europe portal served 28 countries and 24 languages but had grown organically over years without a coherent IA or design system. Citizens struggled to find relevant information for their country and situation.

sections.label: Research
sections.content: Led multilingual UX research with participants from 8 EU countries. Conducted tree testing, card sorting, and accessibility audits (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance). Facilitated workshops in English, Spanish, and French with EC stakeholders.

sections.label: Design System
sections.content: Established the foundational design system: component library, accessibility tokens, multilingual typography scale, and documentation for 12 contributing teams across EU institutions.
